_comment: Copy to .secrets.json (gitignored) and fill in. Generate values with the commands below.
_encryptionKey: Not needed for Azure. Bank credentials are encrypted with a per-user key that is wrapped by a key in Key Vault, which the template creates. ENCRYPTION_KEY is only used for local development, where it stands in for the vault.
_githubOAuth: Create a GitHub OAuth App at https://github.com/settings/developers. Set the Authorization callback URL to the githubOAuthCallbackUrl output of a first deployment (sign-in stays disabled until these are filled in, so deploying once with them empty is fine).
